title: Clean Energy Grid
subtitle: The Power Plant Challenge
missionGoal: Cut average energy load below 60 without depleting the municipal treasury.
initialDialogue: Greetings, Mayor! Our power grid is groaning under peak demand, especially in the Industrial sector. High energy load risks blackouts during heatwaves. Can you invest in Solar or Battery storage to cut our energy load below 60?
successDialogue: Brilliant work, Mayor! The microgrid meters are in the green, and our grid is now vastly more reliable!

title: Transit Gridlock
subtitle: The Transit Station Hub
missionGoal: Relieve Downtown congestion (traffic < 75) while keeping emissions from spiking.
initialDialogue: All aboard, Mayor! Downtown is bumper-to-bumper with cars honking all morning. If we expand electric buses or smart signals, we can clear the jam. Beware though: building more roads adds tailpipe emissions!
successDialogue: Zoom zoom! Downtown traffic is flowing smoothly, and commuters are smiling again!

title: Circular Economy
subtitle: The Recycling Center
missionGoal: Lower Industrial & Residential emissions through waste reduction and clean transit.
initialDialogue: Hello Mayor! Trash is piling up and landfills are venting methane! If we roll out neighborhood waste recycling drives and clean transit, we can drive down emissions and boost citizen happiness!
successDialogue: Incredible turnaround! Zero-waste sorting has cut emissions and local pride is at an all-time high!

title: Fiscal & Social Equity
subtitle: City Hall Chambers
missionGoal: Balance your council priorities and achieve an overall Sustainability Index of at least 65.
initialDialogue: Welcome to council chambers, Mayor! Dollars don't grow on trees. We need a holistic policy portfolio that balances Environment, Happiness, Cost, and Reliability without leaving any zone behind in happiness equity.
successDialogue: Superb leadership! You balanced the budget and lifted quality of life across every neighborhood!

title: The Resilience Test
subtitle: Crisis Command Tower
missionGoal: Survive an unexpected crisis shock and restore city resilience to 70+.
targetCriteria: Resilience Score >= 70 after crisis shock & recovery
initialDialogue: Attention Mayor! A surprise crisis is threatening our city! Will our earlier investments in batteries, solar, or buses hold up, or will the grid buckle? Trigger the emergency protocols and execute the recovery plan!
successDialogue: Outstanding disaster management, Mayor! Our city withstood the shock and bounced back stronger than ever!
